steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Thousands of years ago, Kjeragandr descended into this land, naming it Kjerag and bestowing upon it Her eternal vigil.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: For thousands of years, Her teachings have continued to pervade the lives of all of Kjerag's people.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: She gave Her flesh to the Paleroche clan, Her hide to the Browntail clan, and Her bones to the Silverash clan.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: But we all share a common name –– the people of Kjerag.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Our belief in Her is the foundation of Kjerag, and is also the reason why we stand here today and call ourselves the children of Kjerag.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: We all harbor the greatest respect for Her in our hearts, and work together to survive in this land to this day.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: However, as we all know now, Kjerag is not the only country in this world.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Beyond these snow-capped mountains lies a vast world filled with people who do not look like us, do not speak like us, and do not share our belief in Kjeragandr.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: In the past, we've had terrible disagreements over how to deal with such people.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: In reality, these disagreements are not an existential crisis. Rather, they are Her way of testing us, Her way of guiding us.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: She is the object of faith for all the people of Kjerag, our mother and guardian.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: And as a mother, she never wishes to see her children stagnate.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Therefore...

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Do not let your desire to preserve the old prevent you from trying the new. You are Her children, and you should be full of courage.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Do not let your nostalgia for your homeland prevent you from exploring new places. No matter where you go, She will walk with you.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Do not let what you already possess prevent you from seeking greater ventures, for you have the right to more in life.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: After all, She is tolerant. The land She protects should be tolerant, and Her people should also be tolerant.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: By the authority She has vested in me, I solemnly declare:

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: The Vine-Bead Court will tolerate the beliefs of outsiders towards Kjeragandr.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Furthermore, the Vine-Bead Court encourages all citizens to pursue a better life in their own ways.
In the commemoration of the Saintess of Mount Karlan, the Illuminated One, known as the Blessed Enya Silverash, and the resounding speech she delivered to the people of Kjerag––
This day is officially designated a national religious day throughout the land.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: The incident in the valley began as just an idle move.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I needed someone to distract the Paleroche clan so I could dispatch supplies and personnel in secret.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: If not you, it could've been anyone else.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I planned on apologizing to you after all was said and done.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: But now, I should probably apologize for underestimating the impact you would have.
Enciodes speaks to himself while moving a chess piece.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Gnosis is my good friend, as well as my collaborator.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: He and I do not necessarily see eye to eye – he has his own ideas and methods.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: But I understand him.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: As long as we share the same purpose, he will not betray me, nor do I need to exchange any information with him while executing a plan.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I could sit back and let him employ all his resources in whatever way he deemed efficacious to stymieing the power of the Browntail clan.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Destroying the railroad tracks was just a clever trick. Gnosis gained Ratatos's trust, and also blocked access to spies and Messengers from other countries.
Enciodes looks you in the eye and makes another move.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: It's a draw.
As if foreshadowing the end result, Enciodes takes his hands off the pieces and spreads them out.
It means this round is over.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: It would appear that my luck has been quite rotten lately.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I can't even win at chess anymore.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Sometimes, a draw is a great victory. And other times, a draw is a crushing defeat.

options: In your case, which one is it?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: In my case... anything other than a great victory is a crushing defeat.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: But this time... is indeed an exception.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Without a doubt, I have won.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: But what I didn't expect was that you opened up another possibility for my victory.

options: I didn't have the means to persuade the Saintess to come down from the mountain.
I just wanted to prevent the loss of life.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Yes, another possibility.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I thought that outcome was impossible, but you managed to see through it and influence the situation even without knowing anything.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: That doesn't change the fact that I won.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Perhaps it's been too long since I've had a worthy opponent, but such a close match truly made my heart swell.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: The Saintess... does not need anyone making decisions for her.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: But you nudged her at just the right moment, giving her a direction.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Furthermore, you set the stage for her.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: And you would have me believe that you did all of this unintentionally?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: You certainly achieved this objective.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: You sought out Arctosz and Ratatos, made battle predictions for them preemptively, and provided a better plan to avoid war.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: This very much fits your way of doing things, Doctor.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Even I could not predict that this situation could be resolved in such a peaceful manner.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Surely, you understand why I was so eager to unite Kjerag under one banner.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: That's right.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I don't particularly hate the Vine-Bead Court, nor am I in any rush to eradicate religion from these lands.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Nor am I particularly dissatisfied with Arctosz's insularity or Ratatos's hesitation.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: They don't know the things that happen outside, and thus will not hold the same views as me.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: If I had enough time, I wouldn't mind spending five or ten years, or even longer, changing their minds and changing Kjerag in a gentler way.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: But––

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Kjerag doesn't have enough time. Even if we cannot be considered rich, there are bound to be neighboring countries eyeing this land undisturbed by Catastrophes.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I must push us forward, and if there are people who cannot accept that, then I can only deprive them of their right to object.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: That is all.

options: You don't need to convince me.
These things are none of my business.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I am simply sharing some of my thoughts with people worthy of hearing them.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: You saw these things as a bystander, which is the only reason I'm able to tell you this.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: As far as I know, Arctosz will announce his responsibility for poisoning the Great Elder and resign as head of the clan.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: As for why he decided to make this show of grace, he decided to make an oath with the Saintess so that the she would take control of the Paleroche lands.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Perhaps to cement the Saintess's status.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: The Browntail clan has signed an agreement of subordination to the Silverash clan.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I can share some extra details with you. I have no desire to take over the Browntail clan; should Ratatos desire, her power would not be any less than it was in the past.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: There are no longer any left who desire stagnation, who refuse to budge, or would fret over costs and benefits. None stand in the way of Karlan Trade and Kjerag's development.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: This is an outcome I can accept, Doctor.

options: You and the Saintess aren't so different.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: But we ended up walking separate paths.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: And, this is the result of my past choices. I will take responsibility for it.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: She, too, must bear the consequences of her choices, and lift the people of Kjerag out of this stagnation with her guidance, not my instigation.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: You proved yourself to me and to Kjerag, but you also... proved Enya.

steps.name: Chester
steps.text: Mr. President, it's almost time for the meeting.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Of course.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Regardless, Kjerag is about to undergo massive changes, Doctor.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Next time, it may be difficult for me to meet with you.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: But I can assure you that Rhodes Island is free to come and go anywhere in Kjerag.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Additionally, please accept this token of my goodwill as compensation for involving you and your operators in this incident.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Neither Rhodes Island's name nor yours will appear in any future official records related to this event.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Also, a new contract that will allow us to call each other allies is on its way to Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: After this is all over, I will visit Rhodes Island again.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: And when that time comes, I hope to play another game of chess with you, Doctor.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Kjarr.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: Hm?

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: You've got some guts, you know. How long have you been keeping me in the dark?!

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: Do forgive me, Saintess, for I know not how I have sinned.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Oh? So be it, then.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: But, Kjarr, I do have something I want to ask you.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: Yes, Saintess.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: ...I want to know, was it Her intention for me to become the leader of Kjerag?

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Was all of this Her plan? Me feeling lost and confused throughout this entire chain of events, and then my determination when making that final choice––

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Did She expect all of that?
Kjarr understands why Enya suddenly asks that question now, of all times.
She is afraid.
She is not afraid that she made the wrong decision. But, she is afraid that everything, as far as her eyes can see, is just a game played by gods.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: There is but one thing I can assure you...

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: She... has never once sought to interfere with your free will. Your thoughts have always been your own.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: Who is to say whether Her miracles are nothing more than the wishes and fabrications of Her faithful?

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: Perhaps, She gave everything so that the people of wind and snow would have a pristine land to call home.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: She looks out over this land, searching for ways to bless the people who live here with happiness.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: As for the answer you gave – She acknowledges it, nothing more.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: If that's true, then can you do me a favor?

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: Name the favor.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Please ask Her not to take you away.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Isn't that what always happens in the stories? Though I've found my answer, it comes at the cost of losing you.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: I will not ask favors of Her willy-nilly, so would you continue to be my maid?

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: ...Pfft.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: Haha... Hahaha.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: Sorry, sorry. I didn't expect you to make such a cute request.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: But... let's do this according to chapter three of the scriptures.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: If one day, you no longer uphold the ideals you currently do, then I will no longer stay by your side. But, until then, I swear to serve as your head maid.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: No taking that back, okay?

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: Okay.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: You want me to be your representative to Rhodes Island?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: That's right.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: You can devote yourself to your research at Rhodes Island. I trust it'll be to your liking.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Did you already have that in mind when you invited them?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Just another possibility.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: After all, regardless of whether or not our plans succeed, your situation in Kjerag is only going to get worse.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: You just didn't expect that the person you were trying to win over the most would almost sabotage your plan.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: That takes nothing from our victory.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Though if you want to stay in Kjerag, I can also arrange that for you.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Well, whatever.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: ...I don't mind the infamy, but I'd get annoyed if people kept coming by to throw rocks at my lab's windows.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Also, I'd like to meet this Doctor for myself.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Oh, are you interested?

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: As if. I simply want to see whether your Doctor, who has already left a mark on this land, will end up becoming our enemy.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: And if not?

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Then I'd also like to know–– what level of technical prowess a company that has succeed in suppressing Oripathy possesses.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Gnosis, that gleeful hunger on your face looks about as bad as what you accused me of.

steps.name: Chester
steps.text: Gnosis, your luggage has been prepared. It's time to go.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Of course.

steps.name: Chester
steps.text: Shall we leave now then?

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Just a moment.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Monch!
Nobody responds to Gnosis's call.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: ...Monch?
Within that plain room, everything stands in order – except the girl who always spoke with a hint of gloominess has disappeared.
He immediately spots a dagger sitting on the table in the middle of the room.
He gave that dagger to Monch.
He remains silent for a spell, then picks up the dagger and walks out the door.
The sun is shining outside.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: Hey Doctor, look! They've already started selling Saintess-themed goods here.

steps.name: Kjerag Merchant
steps.text: My, if it isn't Lady Ensia. Welcome back to my humble shop.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: You sure know how to keep up with the times.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: When I came back to Kjerag, you were still selling Vine-Bead Court merch. Now you've switched to selling stuff with the Saintess on it.

steps.name: Kjerag Merchant
steps.text: Hahaha, I'm not the only one. Plenty of folks all over the streets. We're even being encouraged to do business now.

steps.name: Kjerag Merchant
steps.text: Now that you mention it, those things I was hawking before, I didn't actually believe in them.

steps.name: Kjerag Merchant
steps.text: But when I make goods for the Saintess, I have real faith in what I'm doing.

steps.name: Kjerag Merchant
steps.text: When we first heard about the transfer of power, us businessfolks were real worried about what was going to happen.

steps.name: Kjerag Merchant
steps.text: But I never imagined that the Saintess would be so open-minded.

steps.name: Kjerag Merchant
steps.text: Now, even the most stubborn of folk have nothing to say against dealing with foreigners.

steps.name: Kjerag Merchant
steps.text: Also, I heard that Sir Enciodes plans to meet with the Saintess for discussions to fully open Browntail and Paleroche territory to the outside world.

steps.name: Kjerag Merchant
steps.text: If you ask me, I'm looking forward to seeing this new day more and more.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: Hehe.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: I'm glad to hear you say that.

steps.name: Kjerag Merchant
steps.text: You certainly ought to be!

steps.name: Kjerag Merchant
steps.text: Take a look around you. Of all these people walking the street, who isn't smiling these days?

steps.name: Kjerag Merchant
steps.text: Even though all that craziness happened during the ceremony, the Saintess was able to mediate the situation among the three clans.

steps.name: Kjerag Merchant
steps.text: And that resulted in something most people could agree with.

steps.name: Kjerag Merchant
steps.text: Y'know, I have to thank the Saintess and Sir Enciodes for all this.

steps.name: Kjerag Merchant
steps.text: Oh right, were you planning on leaving Kjerag in that getup of yours?

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: Yup, my vacation's coming to an end, so it's time for me to head back to continue my treatment and work.

steps.name: Kjerag Merchant
steps.text: In that case, take whatever you want! It's on me!

steps.name: Kjerag Merchant
steps.text: Treat it like my parting gift to you!

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: Well...

steps.name: Kjerag Merchant
steps.text: No need to be polite. You've earned it.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: Alright, I'll take you up on it then.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: I want this portrait of my sister, this embroidery, and that sculpture.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: Hey, that picture––
A painting hanging on the wall catches Ensia's attention.
It's of her sister Enya and her brother Enciodes, standing at a negotiating table and shaking hands, seemingly reaching some sort of agreement.
For a moment, she pauses.

steps.name: Kjerag Merchant
steps.text: Ah, this painting depicts Sir Enciodes and the Saintess reaching an agreement on Kjerag's future.

steps.name: Kjerag Merchant
steps.text: Though I don't know if this scene actually happened, there's no doubt that those two are the ones governing Kjerag now...

steps.name: Kjerag Merchant
steps.text: And everyone knows they're siblings.

steps.name: Kjerag Merchant
steps.text: Surely, they must get along very well.

steps.name: Kjerag Merchant
steps.text: Tell me, do they really?

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: Yup... Let's see if there's anything else...

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: Doctor, is there anything you want?

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: You got it!

steps.name: Kjerag Merchant
steps.text: Um... Lady Ensia, I did say you could have anything you wanted for free, but please try to have some mercy...

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: ...Doctor.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: Though the two of us serve as Sir Enciodes's retainers, we are also employees of Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: We would like to apologize to you... for all sorts of things.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: Courier and I will not shamelessly ask for your forgiveness. We only hope that we will be allowed to come to Rhodes Island to visit Lady Ensia in the future.

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: What do you think, Doctor?

options: You were in a difficult situation. I understand.
I was a guest of the Paleroches. What does that have to do with you?

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: This situation is indeed excusable, which I'll note in the report.

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: As for how the bosses will respond, that I cannot say.

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: Doctor, I know you don't assign any blame to them.

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: But playing dumb isn't very smart.

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: Coincidentally, you also resolved some of Enciodes's affairs.

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: If that's how you want to spin the account of what happened, then the report to Dr. Kal'tsit will take a bit of extra effort.

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: And I certainly won't help you with that.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: Thank you... Doctor, and Captain Sharp.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: Thanks again.

steps.name: Aurora
steps.text: Doctor, I've already said goodbye to my folks. I'm ready to go now.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Got all your stuff?

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: Instructor Dobermann!

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: The Saintess became the de-facto leader of Kjerag, and Enciodes gained the power to leverage the majority of Kjerag's resources...

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Doctor, you ought to take my advice.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: I didn't hear your name mentioned by anyone else, fortunately. By the looks of things, you people managed to not get involved this time, at least.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: Uhh...

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: By the looks of things, not only did you get yourselves involved, you got heavily involved.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: I look forward to reading your reports.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Alright, if there's anything you have to say, save it for once we're on the road. Get in the car, we're heading back to Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: Doctor, do you remember that painting we saw in that store back there?

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: Mmhmm.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: Doctor, stop playing dumb. I know you remember it.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: Right then and there, I really wanted to buy that painting.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: But after thinking about it some more, I decided not to. I mean, I know that never happened.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: My brother just decided to let my sister have a move, that's all there was to it.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: It's not your fault, Doctor.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: Without you, the tension between those two would've only gotten more vicious.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: But at least this helped me sort one thing out.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: And that is – regardless of which one of them made the decision, it came as a result of their beliefs.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: You were just a catalyst in driving things forward.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: Just like how nobody would try to convince me to give up mountain climbing.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: Beliefs can't be so easily changed.

options: They wouldn't be called beliefs if they could.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: Right.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: But, I have another belief that won't be easily changed.

steps.name: Ensia
steps.text: One day, I'm going to make sure my brother and sister get along again, like they used to.

options: (Perhaps the perils that Kjerag faces have only just begun.)
